pr_title: Fix lifx.set_state so it works with kelvin and color_temp_kelvin and color names
pr_body:
## Proposed change

After the change to kelvin as default color temp unit, the `lifx.set_state` stopped accepting `kelvin` as a parameter.  We also stopped processing color names when we dropped the call to `preprocess_turn_on_alternatives` which is now restored as well. I added a bunch of tests for `lifx.set_state` too.

issue_context.title: LIFx behavior since upgrading to 2022.11
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have a script that alternate changes a LIFx light between 2 colors of my choosing.  It was working fine before 2022.11 but now instead of alternating between the specified colors, it just dims the first color then brightens it again, in alternation.  I have tried this with a strip and a bulb, both of which worked previously, and both are now doing the same thing.  Here is the script:

alias: Front Porch LIFX Holiday Animation
sequence:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.front_porch
    data:
      color_name: red
      brightness_pct: 51
  - delay:
      seconds: 1
  - service: lifx.effect_pulse
    data:
      mode: blink
      brightness: 96
      cycles: 8203
      period: 7.5
      color_name: White
    target:
      entity_id: light.front_porch
mode: restart
icon: mdi:cards-heart


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.11

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.10.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

LIFx

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
alias: Front Porch LIFX Holiday Animation
sequence:
  - service: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.front_porch
    data:
      color_name: red
      brightness_pct: 51
  - delay:
      seconds: 1
  - service: lifx.effect_pulse
    data:
      mode: blink
      brightness: 96
      cycles: 8203
      period: 7.5
      color_name: White
    target:
      entity_id: light.front_porch
mode: restart
icon: mdi:cards-heart
```

Hey guys,

Besides `kelvin`, I've just noticed that `brightness_pct` stopped working in `lifx.set_state` for me but still does work in `light.turn_on`. Is there anyone else experiencing the same issue? Previously, it used to work for years.
@GooRoo yup, not working for me either.
`brightness_pct` has been fixed in the associated PR as well.

Essentially, the `lifx.set_state` service used to use the same method as `light.turn_on` to translate all the various permutations of color and brightness settings into something the `aiolifx` library could actually use. 

When Home Assistant's default color temperature unit changed from Mired to Kelvin, calling this method directly resulted in the wrong kelvin value being used, so I removed the call to the method.

However, the lifx tests (and my own installation) didn't use any of the non-standard parameters like `color_name` or `brightness_pct` (or `color_rgb` or `color_xy`) which is why we didn't catch this during the beta. I've now added tests for those too.
